explication: Lexxy is a Rails-integrated rich-text editor built on Lexical. Users edit formatted content in a custom editor, use toolbar, prompt, table, and attachment interactions, and produce HTML compatible with Action Text. The frontend also provides Markdown behavior, code highlighting, configurable prompts, attachment previews, and sanitization; the Rails engine connects it to Action Text and Active Storage. Several feature modules are represented from the tree and README, but their internal wiring is not shown, so those relationships are omitted.
